hero.title: Software that holds up
hero.description: Custom development, platforms, and consulting with clear scope: systems your team can run and maintain, built for production — not demos that fall apart at month-end or when you need them most.

story.title: We got tired of the same script: big promises, deliveries that fall apart.
story.lead: BITFLOW is for teams that need a digital partner they can sleep on: original, explainable, useful work. If your business runs on software, you deserve better than dressed-up templates and endless patches.

chapters.title: Your ops aren't a cheap experiment lab
chapters.body: Every technical call has to hold up in front of your director, your auditor, or your end customer. So we go for clarity: readable architecture, risks out in the open, and releases you can run on Monday — not only in Friday's demo.

chapters.title: Real software, straight talk
chapters.body: We don't sell empty magic; we don't ship plagiarism or repackage someone else's work as ours; we don't sneak in features just to pad the invoice. We build real software: tested where it counts, documented when it helps, and honest about its limits.

chapters.title: Built to evolve, not to rip out next year
chapters.body: We'd rather say "no" to a requirement that will break your system than say "yes" just to close the deal. We think about whoever maintains the code two years out — sometimes you, sometimes us, sometimes someone new who deserves context, not a graveyard of hacks.

chapters.title: From idea to long term, in the same language
chapters.body: We pull APIs, cloud, data, and product into one thread: fewer "business vs IT" translation meetings, more shared decisions, and a clear trail of why each choice was made.

story.manifestoTitle: Useful, maintainable software — without moral fine print.
story.manifestoBody: At BITFLOW we build digital product for companies that care about time, money, and reputation: engineering that respects your users, your team, and the future of the system. That's what sets us apart from market noise.
story.closing: If you want a team that tells you the technical truth and helps you build something that lasts — you're already in the right place.

successStories.title: Success stories
successStories.subtitle: Recent work across education, retail, agro, health, and logistics — built for LatAm teams and users.

platforms.title: End-to-end academic digital ecosystem
platforms.solution: Multi-program college: mobile app for students and portal for faculty and admin. Live grades, QR attendance in class, elective enrollment, push notices, and tuition module wired to a regional payment gateway.
platforms.tech: React Native · Next.js · NestJS · PostgreSQL · Redis · FCM · payments REST API
platforms.result: Less load on enrollment and comms; faster student inquiries and one channel for official notices.

platforms.title: Inventory and sales in one place
platforms.solution: Chain across several cities: live stock per branch, inter-store transfers, e-invoicing integration, and regional management reporting.
platforms.tech: Next.js · Node.js · TypeScript · PostgreSQL · BullMQ · e-invoicing API
platforms.result: Unified inventory visibility; fewer count discrepancies and quicker month-end closes across stores.

platforms.title: Lot traceability on blockchain
platforms.solution: Exporter: custody chain from field and packing plant to container. QR labels and NFC reads, events on a permissioned ledger, and auditor/buyer portal abroad.
platforms.tech: Hyperledger Fabric · Node.js · Express · React · IPFS (documents) · PostgreSQL off-chain
platforms.result: Origin and movements verified in minutes; smoother audits and clearer answers to buyers.

platforms.title: Scheduling, reminders, and telehealth
platforms.solution: Clinic network: online booking, WhatsApp reminders, concise patient record, and gated video rooms per clinician.
platforms.tech: Vue 3 · Laravel · MySQL · Redis · WhatsApp Business API · WebRTC
platforms.result: Fewer no-shows and a calmer waiting room; better room utilization without double-booking.

platforms.title: Same-day routing and proof of delivery
platforms.solution: Last-mile operator: zone-based courier assignment, map tracking, delivery proof with photo and e-signature, polygon-based pricing.
platforms.tech: React · FastAPI · Python · PostGIS · Mapbox · Celery
platforms.result: More on-time deliveries in the promised window and fewer status disputes.

about.paragraph1: BITFLOW partners with companies and teams that need engineering aligned to the business — from architecture and cloud down to the front-end details your users touch every day.

cta.title: Got a project or a technical pain?
cta.description: Tell us where you are and we'll reply with concrete next steps — no runaround.

q1.question: Do you only work with big companies?
q1.answer: Nope. We also work with SMBs and mid-sized teams. What matters is real impact and a quality bar we can actually commit to.

q2.question: How do you quote a software project?
q2.answer: First we talk, scope it out, and quote you — straight, no runaround. That chat is free. Then we lock deliverables and engagement model (project-based or phased).

q3.question: Do you offer maintenance or support afterward?
q3.answer: Yes. We agree evolutionary support, improvements, or monitoring depending on the product and how critical it is for your business.

q4.question: Is the code and IP ours?
q4.answer: Yes, unless we agree otherwise in writing: what we build for your project is yours. We don't recycle it for competitors or sell someone else's work as ours.

projects.title: Projects built with BITFLOW
projects.subtitle: Products and platforms we took from requirements to production: context, stack, client need, and outcome.
projects.pipeline: More projects in the pipeline — if what you need looks like this, let's talk.

items.title: Shrimp harvest management & traceability platform
items.summary: System to record batches, process stages, and movements from harvest through dispatch, with auditable traceability for export and compliance.
items.need: Get off scattered spreadsheets; one digital flow and prove origin and chain of custody for buyers and audits.
items.tech: Web app and API on Node.js/NestJS, PostgreSQL, document storage, reports and dashboards; cloud deploy with backups and roles per plant or site.
items.outcome: Near–real-time visibility of inventory by batch, fewer traceability errors, and faster answers to customers and certifications.

items.title: Educational management platform for in-person and online classes
items.summary: Unified academic environment: materials, attendance, grades, and communication across faculty, students, and administration.
items.need: Run in-person and remote without duplicating tools; cut admin load and give families and students clarity.
items.tech: React/Next.js frontend, modular backend, relational database, notifications (email/push as designed), integrated or linked video, roles and permissions by campus.
items.outcome: One channel for official notices, cleaner performance tracking, and less friction in enrollment and day-to-day.

items.title: Sports event timing platform
items.summary: App to capture times per participant or team, live rankings, and publishing results during the competition.
items.need: Leave paper or shared-sheet timing behind; fewer disputes and delays when posting official results.
items.tech: Responsive web app and high-throughput API, duplicate protection, panel for judges or officials, optional reader integration or manual entry.
items.outcome: More reliable, faster results, less repetitive work for staff, and a better experience for athletes and spectators.

items.title: Patient & medical appointment management platform
items.summary: Medical scheduling, concise history, reminders, and front-desk flow for clinics or outpatient networks.
items.need: Cut no-shows, prevent double-booking, and organize patient info beyond paper.
items.tech: Vue or React depending on project, backend with appointment rules, WhatsApp or other reminder channels, access patterns aligned with sensitive data.
items.outcome: A fuller schedule without clashes, fewer absences, and reception with context before the visit.

items.title: Events platform
items.summary: Registration, payment or confirmation, badges, and communications for conferences, fairs, or corporate programs.
items.need: Centralize attendees, capacity, and comms; avoid email threads and spreadsheets that go stale within hours.
items.tech: Public portal + admin console, payment gateway when needed, lists and exports, automated notifications.
items.outcome: More predictable event ops, fewer rework cycles, and a smoother experience for attendees and organizers.

items.title: AI-powered app — Manabí gastronomy recommendations
items.summary: Mobile or web experience suggesting dishes, routes, or venues by preference, context, and regional culinary heritage.
items.need: Personalized discovery without hand-curating everything; connect tourism/culture with structured data and a real local voice.
items.tech: React Native or PWA client, recommendation services and business rules, AI models or APIs as designed, curated content in a database.
items.outcome: Users find options that fit their profile faster; the client stands out with a modern, local-first experience.

items.title: Professional landing page for a language school
items.summary: High-conversion site with clear value, levels, modalities, and CTAs toward contact or enrollment.
items.need: A credible web presence that reflects teaching quality; fast mobile loads and consistent messaging, optionally multilingual.
items.tech: Next.js, SEO- and performance-oriented content, forms wired to CRM or email, responsive accessible layout.
items.outcome: More qualified inquiries, fast loads, and a first impression aligned with the school's brand.

items.title: Enrollment & portfolio management platform for an educational institution
items.summary: Control of enrollments, agreements, account status, and academic-financial tracking in one environment.
items.need: Unify student linkage and billing/plans without living on endless Excels and email chains.
items.tech: Web app with roles (finance, registrar, leadership), reporting and export, change audit trails, backups, and granular permissions.
items.outcome: Clearer portfolio visibility by program and cohort, fewer disputes from misaligned data, and faster month-end closes.

items.title: Bulk WhatsApp messaging platform
items.summary: Tool for campaigns and notifications to authorized lists, with templates, queues, and delivery traceability.
items.need: Scale communication without breaking platform policies; track what was sent and avoid mass manual copy-paste errors.
items.tech: Backend with queues (e.g. BullMQ), WhatsApp Business API integration, campaign console, logs and retries, infra ready for traffic spikes.
items.outcome: Governed bulk sends, better visibility of message status, and ops less dependent on spreadsheets.
